<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-api-reference.ts from sdk/openapi.json. Do not edit — including in Studio; the next build replaces this file. -->

::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/estimate"}
#docs
No writes. Prices modified lines, added items and removals in ONE preview, so a confirmation screen can state the whole amount that will move. A change can raise TWO documents — a proration invoice and a credit note — so `total_minor` is the DIFFERENCE between them (negative when the customer is credited) and is NOT `subtotal_minor + tax_minor`: `tax_minor`/`tax_lines` describe the invoice only, and the note’s own tax is in `credit_note_total_minor`. The note is spent in order: first relieving whatever the term's own invoices are still OWED (`credit_applied_to_open_invoices_minor` — the customer's debt is cancelled rather than refunded), then against this invoice, and only what is left over is `refundable_credit_added_minor`, which goes back on the balance. On a fully-paid term the first slice is absent and the note simply exceeds the invoice. `next_renewal` prices the NEXT renewal invoice as it will look after this change (tax and coupons in, that credit applied) so a confirmation screen never has to sum line amounts itself. On an in-trial subscription nothing is charged now: `amount_due_minor` is 0, `due_at_trial_end` is set, `next_renewal` is null, and the lines describe the full post-change composition the trial-end invoice will raise.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `coupon_code` | `string` | no | A coupon to apply AS PART OF this change. Applied inside the change's own transaction, BEFORE its proration invoice is raised — so the proration is discounted, which is the intended behaviour. Posting it as a separate call afterwards bills the proration at list price. `POST …/estimate` takes the same field and previews the same result. |
| `coupon_ids` | `array of string` | no | The same coupon as `coupon_code`, as a list. A subscription carries ONE discount at a time, so more than one entry is refused (400), as is a `coupon_code` naming a different coupon. |
| `manual_discount` | `object` | no | A manual discount to apply as part of this change — same shape `POST …/subscriptions/{sub}/manual_discount` takes, minus `note`, so one screen sends one body shape to the preview and the booking. `duration` defaults to `forever`. |
| `manual_discount.type` | `string` | **yes** | The discount type. One of `percent`, `amount`. |
| `manual_discount.value` | `number` | **yes** | 1–100 for `percent`; minor units for `amount`. |
| `manual_discount.duration` | `string` | no | How long the discount lasts. One of `one_time`, `forever`. |
| `remove_discount` | `boolean` | no | Remove the subscription's active discount (coupon or manual) as part of this change, inside its transaction and BEFORE the proration invoice is raised — so that invoice bills without it. With `coupon_code` or `manual_discount` it swaps the discount in one edit. On the estimate it prices the same order. |
| `changes` | `array of object` | no | Existing items to change. |
| `changes.item` | `string` | **yes** | The subscription item's id (si_…). |
| `changes.price` | `string` | no | The new price's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro-monthly-usd`). |
| `changes.quantity` | `integer` | no | The new quantity. |
| `changes.unit_price_minor` | `integer` | no | Custom price override (flat/per-unit only), minor units |
| `adds` | `array of object` | no | Items that would be added (`POST …/items`). A plan-scoped differential price is resolved exactly as the add would resolve it. |
| `adds.price` | `string` | **yes** | The price's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro-monthly-usd`). |
| `adds.quantity` | `integer` | no | The quantity. |
| `adds.unit_price_minor` | `integer` | no | A unit price for this add, in minor units, in place of the price's own. |
| `removes` | `array of string` | no | Subscription item ids that would be removed (`DELETE …/items/:id`); each previews a prorated credit for unused time. |
| `at` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | The time to estimate for (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `reset_term` | `boolean` | no | True to estimate with a new term starting at `at`. |
| `prorate` | `boolean` | no | Mirrors SubscriptionChange's `prorate`, so a preview of an unprorated change quotes what that change will actually book. False suppresses the prorated credit and charge; on a term reset the full new-term charge survives and only the unused-time credit drops, so clearing it there RAISES the total rather than zeroing it. Defaults to `true`. |
| `change_option` | `string` | no | `specific_date` previews the edit as `POST …/schedule` (type `change`) applies it at `changes_scheduled_at`, priced from today's state. A scheduled change carries only `changes`/`adds`/`removes`, so a coupon, manual discount, `prorate` or `reset_term` alongside it is refused (400). `end_of_term` previews it as a change scheduled for the current term end (the trial end in a trial) books it at that instant: nothing is left to prorate, and `next_renewal` is the renewal at the new composition. `prorate` and `reset_term` are refused (400); a coupon or manual discount is previewed onto that renewal. One of `immediately`, `specific_date`, `end_of_term`. |
| `changes_scheduled_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | Required with `change_option=specific_date`; must be in the future and inside the current term. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `estimate`. One of `estimate`. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency code. |
| `lines` | `array of object` | The quoted lines. |
| `subtotal_minor` | `integer` | The sum of the lines, in minor units. |
| `discount_minor` | `integer` | Every discount off the subtotal, in minor units. |
| `tax_minor` | `integer` | The tax, in minor units. |
| `tax_lines` | `array of object` | The tax, split into the rows the invoice prints. |
| `discount_lines` | `array of object` | The discount, split into named rows. |
| `total_minor` | `integer` | Subtotal minus discount plus tax, in minor units. Goes negative on a downgrade. |
| `immediate_charge` | `boolean` | True if the customer is charged now; false if the net is a credit. |
| `credits_applied_minor` | `integer` | Refundable and excess credit that the estimate applies, in minor units. |
| `promotional_credits_applied_minor` | `integer` | Promotional credit that the estimate applies, in minor units. |
| `promotional_discount_minor` | `integer` | Promotional credit as a pre-tax discount, in minor units. |
| `refundable_credits_applied_minor` | `integer` | Refundable credit that the estimate applies, in minor units. |
| `excess_payments_applied_minor` | `integer` | Excess payments that the estimate applies, in minor units. |
| `grant_credits_pre_tax_minor` | `integer` | Credit grants applied before tax (promotional, and paid credit taxed at purchase). Already off `total_minor`. |
| `grant_credits_post_tax_minor` | `integer` | Money credit grants taxed at use, applied after tax. Included in `credits_applied_minor`. |
| `credit_note_total_minor` | `integer` | The total of the credit notes the change raises, tax included, in minor units. |
| `refunded_to_payment_method_minor` | `integer` | Change estimate only, with `billing_rules_config.downgrade_credit: refund` (or the portal customer's selection): the part of the change's credit that is refunded to the card or bank payments that paid. The rest stays as `refundable_credit_added_minor`. |
| `refundable_credit_added_minor` | `integer` | Credit that lands on the customer's balance, in minor units. |
| `credit_applied_to_open_invoices_minor` | `integer` | Credit that pays down open invoices, in minor units. |
| `credit_applied_to_this_invoice_minor` | `integer` | Credit that offsets this invoice, in minor units. |
| `credit_destinations` | `array of object` | Where the credit goes. |
| `credited_period_start` | `string · ISO-8601` | Start of the period that is credited (ISO 8601). |
| `credited_period_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | End of the period that is credited (ISO 8601). |
| `invoice_total_minor` | `integer` | The total of the invoice this change raises, in minor units. |
| `invoice_subtotal_minor` | `integer` | The subtotal of the invoice this change raises, in minor units. |
| `credit_returned_to_buckets_minor` | `integer` | Credit that returns to promotional or excess balance, in minor units. |
| `credit_returned_to_grants_minor` | `integer` | Credit given back to the credit grants the source invoices drew, in minor units. Inside credit_returned_to_buckets_minor. |
| `credit_stranded_minor` | `integer` | Credit that reaches nobody, in minor units. |
| `credit_routing_over_claimed_minor` | `integer` | Credit that routing claimed in excess, in minor units. |
| `amount_due_minor` | `integer` | What the customer is asked to pay now, in minor units. |
| `next_renewal` | `object` | The renewal invoice that the change leads to. |
| `term_reset` | `boolean` | True if the change starts a new billing term. |
| `new_period_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | The end of the new term (ISO 8601), or null. |
| `due_at_trial_end` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the first charge is due, if the subscription starts in a trial. |
| `in_term_reactivation` | `object` | Set when a reactivation can resume the current term. |
| `in_term_available` | `boolean` | True if the subscription can resume its current term. |
| `scheduled_change` | `object` | Renewal estimate only: the scheduled change that runs before this renewal and whose items it prices. |
| `mandate_shortfall` | `object` | Set when the amount is above the mandate's per-debit limit. |
| `debits_in_flight` | `array of object` | Debits that are already under way. |
| `priced_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | Only on `POST …/subscriptions/{sub}/estimate`: the instant these amounts are priced at. Send it to `/change` with `quote`. |
| `quote` | `string` | Only on `POST …/subscriptions/{sub}/estimate`: a hash of the amounts shown. Send it to `/change` with `priced_at`. |
| `change_policy` | `object` | Only on `POST …/subscriptions/{sub}/estimate`: the business's plan-change rules for this edit. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Estimate |
| `400` | Invalid change, or a coupon the apply would refuse: not yet valid, expired, at its redemption limit, or used by this customer as often as it allows |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/estimate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "coupon_code": "welcome-10",
    "remove_discount": false
  }'
```
